name: Aikuutori
source:
Tobari the sparrow and Sei the crow, secretly in love, survived as companions in the city by scavenging human garbage from day to day. Sei provided for them both, and when gentler Tobari disliked the smell of urban offerings, it seemed a simple solution for Sei to fly into unfamiliar mountains to gather purer foods. 

Yet, reality is unkind---observing this scene was Azuma, the own with the daring smile. 

The gears begin to turn in this story of life and survival for three winged men.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126337.html]DLsite English[/url]]
